svg.title: Parchi
svg.desc: Case file for Parchi, built for Google Build with AI 2026, Track 04. A pesticide dealer's chit for tomato lists Malathion 50 EC and Monocrotophos 36 SL; a rule engine checks them against India's CIB&RC register and flags them as banned on this crop and a stopped formulation. A stamp cycles the verdict, do not spray this, through 11 Indian languages. Quote: The model reads and explains. It never decides.
